_note: The custom HubSpot properties the workflows write, and the property group they live in. scripts/hubspot-setup.mjs creates whatever is missing in a real portal (POST /crm/v3/properties/{objectType} and /groups); the mock serves the same definitions as an already set-up portal. Every other property the workflows write (email, phone, firstname, lastname, address, city, state, zip, dealname, amount, pipeline, dealstage) is a HubSpot default property.

contacts.name: ridgeway_lead_status
contacts.label: Ridgeway lead status
contacts.description: new_lead, needs_review, out_of_area (or customer on seeded records). Written by the lead workflow.

contacts.name: ridgeway_tags
contacts.label: Ridgeway tags
contacts.description: out-of-area or needs-review. Written by the lead workflow.

contacts.name: ridgeway_last_inquiry
contacts.label: Ridgeway last inquiry
contacts.description: The customer's own message (first 2,000 characters). Kept in the CRM so other systems only get ids.

contacts.name: ridgeway_pest_type
contacts.label: Ridgeway pest type
contacts.description: The model's pest label, when the lead was qualified.

deals.name: ridgeway_event_id
deals.label: Ridgeway event id
deals.description: The sender's event id. Unique, so the workflow reads the deal with ?idProperty=ridgeway_event_id and a second create conflicts instead of duplicating.
